## How has it been tested?

<!-- Tests, and anything you tried for real: which platform, Pixi version, IDE. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/), e.g. `fix: ...` or `feat: ...`
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and pass (`pixi run test`)
- [ ] Documentation regenerated if roxygen comments changed (`pixi run document`, or comment `/document`)
- [ ] Formatted with [air](https://posit-dev.github.io/air/) (`pixi run format`, or comment `/style`)
- [ ] A `NEWS.md` bullet for a user-facing change, under the development version
- [ ] If AI tools helped: I've read and understood every change, and tested it myself
